Verses.1: Six days later, Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and his brother John. He led them up onto a high mountain by themselves.
Verses.2: There, Jesus was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His garments became as white as pure light.
Verses.3: Behold, just then  Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Jesus.
Verses.4: Peter began saying to Jesus, "Lord it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will make three tabernacles here. One for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
Verses.5: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud consumed them. Behold, a voice out of the cloud said, "This is My beloved Son with whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!"
Verses.6: When the disciples heard this, they fell face down and were filled with terror.
Verses.7: Then Jesus came to them, touched them, and said, "Get up, and do not be afraid."
Verses.8: They raised their eyes and saw no one there except Jesus, alone by Himself.
Verses.9: While they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, "Tell no one the vision you saw until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."
Verses.10: And His disciples asked Him, "Why then do the scribes say that first Elijah must come?"
Verses.11: He answered, "Elijah does come, and he will restore all things.
Verses.12: But I tell you that Elijah already came! They did not recognize him, and they did whatever they wanted to him. So the Son of Man is also going to suffer at their hands."
Verses.13: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.
